mapper.sql: SELECT co.id as offering_id, co.course_catalog_id, co.teacher_id, co.academic_year, co.semester, co.course_day, co.course_time, co.capacity, co.classroom_id, cc.name as course_name, cc.course_code, cc.credits, t.name as teacher_name, cr.name as classroom_name, ocl.class_id, ocl.course_type, c.name as class_name FROM course_offerings co JOIN course_catalogs cc ON co.course_catalog_id = cc.id LEFT JOIN teachers t ON co.teacher_id = t.id LEFT JOIN classrooms cr ON co.classroom_id = cr.id LEFT JOIN offering_class_links ocl ON co.id = ocl.course_offering_id LEFT JOIN classes c ON ocl.class_id = c.id
mapper.select: ORDER BY co.academic_year, co.semester, co.id, c.id
WHERE co.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY co.id, c.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_offerings(course_catalog_id, teacher_id, academic_year, semester, course_day, course_time, capacity, classroom_id) VALUES (#{courseCatalogId}, #{teacherId}, #{academicYear}, #{semester}, #{courseDay}, #{courseTime}, #{capacity}, #{classroomId})
mapper.update: UPDATE course_offerings SET course_catalog_id = #{courseCatalogId}, teacher_id = #{teacherId}, academic_year = #{academicYear}, semester = #{semester}, course_day = #{courseDay}, course_time = #{courseTime}, capacity = #{capacity}, classroom_id = #{classroomId} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_offerings WHERE course_catalog_id = #{courseCatalogId}
SELECT id FROM course_offerings WHERE course_catalog_id = #{courseCatalogId}
